traits.name: Osyluth Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 2d6 (2d6) poison damage, enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 2 3d6 (3d6) poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 3 3d6 (3d6) poison damage and enfeebled 2. (1 round)

traits.name: Quick Invisibility
traits.text: The osyluth can cast innate invisibility using only 1 action.

traits.name: Sadistic Strike
traits.text: An osyluth deals an extra 2d6 (2d6) damage whenever they Strike an enfeebled, frightened, or prone creature.

traits.name: Stygian Inquisitor
traits.text: ⬻ (linguistic, mental); The osyluth telepathically questions a creature affected by zone of truth. After 1 round, if the creature intentionally refuses to answer the question, it takes 2d6 (2d6) mental damage.

traits.name: Tail Sweep
traits.text: ⬻ The osyluth sweeps their tail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed at a DC 26 Reflex save or be knocked prone.
